package http

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"

	adminv1 "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/admin/v1"
	adminhandlers "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/admin/v1/handlers"
	adminmw "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/admin/v1/middleware"
	apiv1 "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"
	apimw "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1/middleware"
	privatehttp "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/private"
	privatehandlers "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
)

// RouterDependencies collects handlers.
type RouterDependencies struct {
	CourseHandler                    *handlers.CourseHandler
	TrackHandler                     *handlers.TrackHandler
	CourseLevelHandler               *handlers.CourseLevelHandler
	CourseGroupHandler               *handlers.CourseGroupHandler
	ModuleHandler                    *handlers.ModuleHandler
	SectionHandler                   *handlers.SectionHandler
	LessonHandler                    *handlers.LessonHandler
	LessonRelationsHandler           *handlers.LessonRelationsHandler
	LessonExamplesHandler            *handlers.LessonExamplesHandler
	ExampleRelationsHandler          *handlers.ExampleRelationsHandler
	TaskHandler                      *handlers.TaskHandler
	PositionHandler                  *handlers.PositionHandler
	AdminCourseHandler               *adminhandlers.CourseHandler
	AdminTrackHandler                *adminhandlers.TrackHandler
	AdminCourseLevelHandler          *adminhandlers.CourseLevelHandler
	AdminCourseGroupHandler          *adminhandlers.CourseGroupHandler
	AdminTrackRelationsHandler       *adminhandlers.TrackRelationsHandler
	AdminLevelRelationsHandler       *adminhandlers.LevelRelationsHandler
	AdminCourseGroupRelationsHandler *adminhandlers.CourseGroupRelationsHandler
	AdminModuleHandler               *adminhandlers.ModuleHandler
	AdminModuleRelationsHandler      *adminhandlers.ModuleRelationsHandler
	AdminSectionHandler              *adminhandlers.SectionHandler
	AdminSectionRelationsHandler     *adminhandlers.SectionRelationsHandler
	AdminLessonHandler               *adminhandlers.LessonHandler
	AdminLessonRelationsHandler      *adminhandlers.LessonRelationsHandler
	AdminLessonExamplesHandler       *adminhandlers.LessonExamplesHandler
	AdminExampleRelationsHandler     *adminhandlers.ExampleRelationsHandler
	AdminTaskHandler                 *adminhandlers.TaskHandler
	AdminTechHandler                 *adminhandlers.TechHandler
	AdminTechVersionHandler          *adminhandlers.TechVersionHandler
	AdminTagHandler                  *adminhandlers.TagHandler
	AdminComposeConfigHandler        *adminhandlers.ComposeConfigHandler
	AdminCourseI18nHandler           *adminhandlers.CourseI18nHandler
	AdminCourseRelationsHandler      *adminhandlers.CourseRelationsHandler
	AdminPositionHandler             *adminhandlers.PositionHandler
	AdminPositionRelationsHandler    *adminhandlers.PositionRelationsHandler
	AdminCodeStructureTypeHandler    *adminhandlers.CodeStructureTypeHandler
	AdminKnowledgeImportBatchHandler *adminhandlers.KnowledgeImportBatchHandler
	PrivateTaskHandler               *privatehandlers.TaskHandler
	PrivateLessonHandler             *privatehandlers.LessonHandler
	PrivateKnowledgeIdentityHandler  *privatehandlers.KnowledgeIdentityHandler
	PrivateGeneratedCourseHandler    *privatehandlers.GeneratedCourseHandler
	Validator                        *validator.Validate
	InternalToken                    string
	LearningPlannerInternalToken     string
	DiagnosticCatalogInternalToken   string
}

// NewRouter builds chi router with middleware.
func NewRouter(deps RouterDependencies) http.Handler {
	root := chi.NewRouter()

	if deps.TrackHandler == nil {
		deps.TrackHandler = &handlers.TrackHandler{}
	}
	if deps.CourseLevelHandler == nil {
		deps.CourseLevelHandler = &handlers.CourseLevelHandler{}
	}
	if deps.CourseGroupHandler == nil {
		deps.CourseGroupHandler = &handlers.CourseGroupHandler{}
	}
	if deps.LessonRelationsHandler == nil {
		deps.LessonRelationsHandler = &handlers.LessonRelationsHandler{}
	}
	if deps.LessonExamplesHandler == nil {
		deps.LessonExamplesHandler = &handlers.LessonExamplesHandler{}
	}
	if deps.ExampleRelationsHandler == nil {
		deps.ExampleRelationsHandler = &handlers.ExampleRelationsHandler{}
	}

	if deps.AdminCourseHandler == nil {
		deps.AdminCourseHandler = &adminhandlers.CourseHandler{}
	}
	if deps.AdminTrackHandler == nil {
		deps.AdminTrackHandler = &adminhandlers.TrackHandler{}
	}
	if deps.AdminCourseLevelHandler == nil {
		deps.AdminCourseLevelHandler = &adminhandlers.CourseLevelHandler{}
	}
	if deps.AdminCourseGroupHandler == nil {
		deps.AdminCourseGroupHandler = &adminhandlers.CourseGroupHandler{}
	}
	if deps.AdminTrackRelationsHandler == nil {
		deps.AdminTrackRelationsHandler = &adminhandlers.TrackRelationsHandler{}
	}
	if deps.AdminLevelRelationsHandler == nil {
		deps.AdminLevelRelationsHandler = &adminhandlers.LevelRelationsHandler{}
	}
	if deps.AdminCourseGroupRelationsHandler == nil {
		deps.AdminCourseGroupRelationsHandler = &adminhandlers.CourseGroupRelationsHandler{}
	}
	if deps.AdminModuleHandler == nil {
		deps.AdminModuleHandler = &adminhandlers.ModuleHandler{}
	}
	if deps.AdminModuleRelationsHandler == nil {
		deps.AdminModuleRelationsHandler = &adminhandlers.ModuleRelationsHandler{}
	}
	if deps.AdminSectionHandler == nil {
		deps.AdminSectionHandler = &adminhandlers.SectionHandler{}
	}
	if deps.AdminSectionRelationsHandler == nil {
		deps.AdminSectionRelationsHandler = &adminhandlers.SectionRelationsHandler{}
	}
	if deps.AdminLessonHandler == nil {
		deps.AdminLessonHandler = &adminhandlers.LessonHandler{}
	}
	if deps.AdminLessonRelationsHandler == nil {
		deps.AdminLessonRelationsHandler = &adminhandlers.LessonRelationsHandler{}
	}
	if deps.AdminLessonExamplesHandler == nil {
		deps.AdminLessonExamplesHandler = &adminhandlers.LessonExamplesHandler{}
	}
	if deps.AdminExampleRelationsHandler == nil {
		deps.AdminExampleRelationsHandler = &adminhandlers.ExampleRelationsHandler{}
	}
	if deps.AdminTaskHandler == nil {
		deps.AdminTaskHandler = &adminhandlers.TaskHandler{}
	}
	if deps.AdminTechHandler == nil {
		deps.AdminTechHandler = &adminhandlers.TechHandler{}
	}
	if deps.AdminTechVersionHandler == nil {
		deps.AdminTechVersionHandler = &adminhandlers.TechVersionHandler{}
	}
	if deps.AdminTagHandler == nil {
		deps.AdminTagHandler = &adminhandlers.TagHandler{}
	}
	if deps.AdminComposeConfigHandler == nil {
		deps.AdminComposeConfigHandler = &adminhandlers.ComposeConfigHandler{}
	}
	if deps.AdminCourseI18nHandler == nil {
		deps.AdminCourseI18nHandler = &adminhandlers.CourseI18nHandler{}
	}
	if deps.AdminCourseRelationsHandler == nil {
		deps.AdminCourseRelationsHandler = &adminhandlers.CourseRelationsHandler{}
	}
	if deps.AdminPositionHandler == nil {
		deps.AdminPositionHandler = &adminhandlers.PositionHandler{}
	}
	if deps.AdminPositionRelationsHandler == nil {
		deps.AdminPositionRelationsHandler = &adminhandlers.PositionRelationsHandler{}
	}
	if deps.AdminCodeStructureTypeHandler == nil {
		deps.AdminCodeStructureTypeHandler = &adminhandlers.CodeStructureTypeHandler{}
	}

	if deps.InternalToken != "" || deps.LearningPlannerInternalToken != "" || deps.DiagnosticCatalogInternalToken != "" {
		internal := privatehttp.NewRouter(
			deps.PrivateTaskHandler,
			deps.PrivateLessonHandler,
			deps.PrivateKnowledgeIdentityHandler,
			deps.PrivateGeneratedCourseHandler,
			deps.InternalToken,
			deps.LearningPlannerInternalToken,
			deps.DiagnosticCatalogInternalToken,
		)
		root.Mount("/internal", internal)
	}

	api := apiv1.NewRouter(deps.CourseHandler, deps.TrackHandler, deps.CourseLevelHandler, deps.CourseGroupHandler, deps.ModuleHandler, deps.SectionHandler, deps.LessonHandler, deps.LessonRelationsHandler, deps.LessonExamplesHandler, deps.ExampleRelationsHandler, deps.TaskHandler, deps.PositionHandler)
	apiWithAuth := chi.NewRouter()
	apiWithAuth.Use(apimw.AuthMiddleware)
	apiWithAuth.Mount("/", api)
	root.Mount("/api/v1", apiWithAuth)

	registerAdminRoutes := func(adminRouter chi.Router) {
		adminRouter.Use(adminmw.AuthMiddleware)
		adminv1.RegisterRoutes(
			adminRouter,
			deps.AdminCourseHandler,
			deps.AdminTrackHandler,
			deps.AdminCourseLevelHandler,
			deps.AdminCourseGroupHandler,
			deps.AdminTrackRelationsHandler,
			deps.AdminLevelRelationsHandler,
			deps.AdminCourseGroupRelationsHandler,
			deps.AdminModuleHandler,
			deps.AdminModuleRelationsHandler,
			deps.AdminSectionHandler,
			deps.AdminSectionRelationsHandler,
			deps.AdminLessonHandler,
			deps.AdminLessonRelationsHandler,
			deps.AdminLessonExamplesHandler,
			deps.AdminExampleRelationsHandler,
			deps.AdminTaskHandler,
			deps.AdminTechHandler,
			deps.AdminTechVersionHandler,
			deps.AdminTagHandler,
			deps.AdminComposeConfigHandler,
			deps.AdminCourseI18nHandler,
			deps.AdminCourseRelationsHandler,
			deps.AdminPositionHandler,
			deps.AdminPositionRelationsHandler,
			deps.AdminCodeStructureTypeHandler,
		)
		if deps.AdminKnowledgeImportBatchHandler != nil {
			adminRouter.With(adminmw.RequireRole("ADMIN", "MODERATOR")).Post(
				"/knowledge-import/batch",
				deps.AdminKnowledgeImportBatchHandler.Apply,
			)
		}
	}
	root.Group(registerAdminRoutes)
	root.Route("/admin/v1", registerAdminRoutes)

	root.NotFound(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNotFound)
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{"error": "not found"})
	})
	return root
}
